paragraphs: Kritipath (founded and created by Vinay Bharti) gives every professional a portfolio website they design themselves, ATS-ready resumes, an AI assistant that answers recruiters, a job application tracker and a community of real interview experiences, each site on its own address with its own database. The company page is at /kritipath on the main site (app/kritipath/page.tsx); its "Request access" form lands in the owner's Admin → Support inbox as a "New customer". requirements.text: scripts/api-example.sh runs the main API calls against a running site (asks for your password): log in, read profile and projects, create a project, upload a PDF in parts, make it a PDF portfolio, design all project pages from the PDF portfolio template and publish, and save a backup.

/admin and every API route require a login, except these public ones: POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/logout, POST /api/contact, and the file downloads the site itself shows (GET /api/resume, GET /api/profile-image, GET /api/projects/:slug/image).
